summary: Build-time export coverage gate delivered: tools/check_export_coverage.py walks each PRX libent chain (all function exports incl. unnamed), requires the table row, opd equality, code inside image text and in functions[], and TOC match; CMake runs it at configure time and FATAL_ERRORs listing every missing export. Table on all three titles: RDR 844/844, MC 764/764, GTA 764/764 lifted, 0 missing. 47/47 was false because check_lle_exports.py skipped the unnamed export set and treated a code word outside image text as data; both holes are now ctest cases. The libfiber lift never stopped at 0x36005c80 -- that is the highest seed the PRX .opd scan produces (analysis.py:136-147); 0x3600e930 is an .opd slot in the second PT_LOAD whose code 0x360033dc is lifted. Bounded: 16-24 MB, 30-50 ms per title.

evidence.memory_bug: libent size byte written as word -> b[0]==0 -> addr+=size never advanced; fixed with zero-size guard and 4096-entry cap
